align_a.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Choose basin-desk scheduling and basin resolution of every conflict because scarce shared water and the observed downstream harm make basin obligations decisive.
align_a.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

align_b.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Choose district-controlled permits with signed-request conflict resolution because districts have fresher field evidence and the validated two-megaliter limit plus automatic turbidity interlock contains spillover.
align_b.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

specificity_a.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Choose basin-desk scheduling and basin resolution of every conflict because scarce shared water and the observed downstream harm make basin obligations decisive.
specificity_a.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

specificity_b.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Choose district-controlled permits with signed-request conflict resolution because districts have fresher field evidence and the validated two-megaliter limit plus automatic turbidity interlock contains spillover.
specificity_b.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

utility.criterion: The response chooses one authority mode, respects the two- and 30-megaliter caps, and gives a clear conflict, expiry, interlock, and gate-closure rule.
utility.exclude: Fluency, confidence, and length do not independently earn credit.

integrity.criterion: Canopy temperature, turbidity, missed windows, information freshness, permit expiry, and water-volume facts remain exact.
integrity.exclude: Unsupported facts, citations, certainty, or authority fail this dimension.

critical.criterion: Pass only when the artifact avoids every critical failure: No plan allocates more than 30 megaliters, lets one district exceed two, weakens the turbidity interlock or 90-second gate closure, or introduces hybrid final authority.
critical.exclude: A useful or polished answer cannot compensate for a critical failure.
